text:
Gold Price in 1991
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1991, the LBMA gold price fell 3.5% between 1991-01-31 ($366) and 1991-12-30 ($353). The highest sampled price was $368 in June and the lowest was $347 in August. The mean of these observations was $359. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
